title: Scoped key references instead of pasted secrets everywhere
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Configs and agent adapters refer to keys by name/scope; the secret is resolved at use and never written into another file. Tests zc_key_scope_*.
